[[File:AdvancedSLAM-SWZ.png|thumb|right|300px|A [[BTL-S8 K-wing assault starfighter]] using advanced SLAM propulsion]]
The '''SubLight Acceleration Motor''', abbreviated to '''SLAM''', was an overdrive system that allowed the [[Missile Boat]] to double its [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight]] speed.

By drawing energy from the missile boat's laser cannon reserves, SLAM provided a burst of acceleration from the [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engines]] to enhance the Missile Boat's combat capabilities. SLAM allowed a Missile Boat to unleash its massive warhead load against a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]], and then flee any enemy [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] or anti-starfighter [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]].

A similar system was later used on the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[BTL-S8 K-wing assault starfighter|K-wing]] assault starfighter.
